My legs have been hurting so much for about a week, especially at night when I'm trying to sleep. It hurts in both of my legs, and I feel too tired to even play at school.
I understand, that sounds very difficult for you. Have you noticed if your fever comes and goes at certain times, and where exactly are you seeing these bruises? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear

I'm sorry to hear you've been feeling so unwell. Have you had any nosebleeds or noticed any weight loss recently? 

REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Aspiration
